name: graphql-tla
description: GraphQL's spec as TLA+: hand-written references for execution, validation, coercion, the type system, introspection and the language, a conformance kit that checks any implementation against them, and models of mutations, subscriptions, @defer and @stream, all model checked with tla-ts

scripts.check: npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:specs && npm run check:graphql-js && npm run check:vectors && npm run check:differentials
scripts.check:differentials: node scripts/differential-lexer.mjs && node scripts/differential-validation.mjs && node scripts/differential-coercion.mjs && node scripts/differential-type-system.mjs
scripts.check:mutants: node scripts/differential-lexer.mjs --mutants && node scripts/differential-validation.mjs --mutants && node scripts/differential-coercion.mjs --mutants && node scripts/differential-type-system.mjs --mutants
